name: Form
description: Form wrapper: label layout, size/disabled cascading to every control, and scrollToFirstError() for server-side validation.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: Stack labels above controls, or place them in a left gutter.

props.name: labelWidth
props.description: Gutter width when labelPosition is left.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every control and blocks interaction.

events.name: submit
events.description: Form submitted; native submission is prevented.

example:
<s-form label-position="left" label-width="160px" :disabled="saving" @submit="save">
  <s-form-item label="Guest name" required :error="errors.name">
    <s-input v-model="form.name" />
  </s-form-item>
  <s-button type="submit">Save</s-button>
</s-form>

// after a 422 response
const form = useTemplateRef('form')
form.value.scrollToFirstError()
